params.body:
The Patterns timeline showed 875 patterns on 2 October against around 300 the days before. Only 16 patterns were found that day.

The page counted each pattern on the day of its last signal, so every pattern that received a signal today moved onto today and the newest bar was always the tallest. The list now carries `createdAt` (when the machine found the pattern), and the dashboard counts new patterns per day from it.

Measured on production: by last signal, 875 / 281 / 317 for 2 Oct / 1 Oct / 30 Sep; by creation, 16 / 8 / 13.

984 tests pass.
params.title: Patterns list carries createdAt
